name: adp-web-experience
description: Les Ateliers de Paul — The Possibility Machine (Next.js 15 App Router)

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const s=p.resolve('node_modules/@next/swc-wasm-nodejs'),d=p.resolve('node_modules/next/wasm');if(fs.existsSync(s)&&!fs.existsSync(d)){try{fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('✓ SWC WASM bindings linked to next/wasm');}catch(e){console.warn('postinstall notice:',e.message);}}"
